description: 翻译质量评估模块三功能测试数据

功能一_单条评估.说明: 复制原文点先翻译→填入参考译文→点计算BLEU

测试样例.原文: 消融实验验证了每个模块对整体性能的贡献。
测试样例.参考译文: Ablation experiments validated the contribution of each module to overall performance.

测试样例.原文: 根据合同条款，违约方应承担赔偿责任。
测试样例.参考译文: According to the contract terms, the breaching party shall bear liability for damages.

测试样例.原文: 双盲随机对照试验证实了新药的安全性与有效性。
测试样例.参考译文: Double-blind randomized controlled trials confirmed the safety and efficacy of the new drug.

测试样例.原文: 该算法的复杂度为O(n log n)，空间复杂度为O(n)。
测试样例.参考译文: The algorithm has a time complexity of O(n log n) and a space complexity of O(n).

测试样例.原文: この研究は機械翻訳の精度を大幅に向上させました。
测试样例.参考译文: This research has significantly improved the accuracy of machine translation.

功能二_批量评估.说明: 点批量评估→设样本数10→开始自动评估，系统从语料库抽样翻译后自动对比
功能二_批量评估.预期: 表格显示原文/模型翻译/参考译文/BLEU/METEOR，顶部显示平均分

功能三_人工打分.说明: 复制源文和翻译结果→拖动1-5分滑块→勾选错误类型→提交评分

测试样例.源文本: 近年来，深度学习技术在医疗影像分析领域取得了突破性进展。卷积神经网络能够自动从大规模医学影像数据集中提取层次化特征。
测试样例.翻译结果: In recent years, deep learning technology has made breakthrough progress in medical image analysis. Convolutional neural networks can automatically extract hierarchical features from large-scale medical image datasets.
测试样例.参考译文: In recent years, deep learning techniques have achieved significant breakthroughs in medical imaging analysis. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) can automatically extract hierarchical features from large-scale medical imaging datasets.
测试样例.备注: technology→techniques更学术; breakthrough progress不太地道; 缺CNN缩写

测试样例.源文本: 本协议自双方签署之日起生效，有效期为三年。
测试样例.翻译结果: This agreement will take effect from the date of signing by both parties, with a valid period of three years.
测试样例.参考译文: This Agreement shall become effective upon execution by both parties and shall remain in force for a term of three years.
测试样例.备注: 生效之日起→shall/upon execution更符合法律英语; 有效期→term比valid period准确

测试样例.源文本: 谢谢你帮了我这么大的忙，改天请你吃饭。
测试样例.翻译结果: Thank you for helping me so much. I will treat you to dinner someday.
测试样例.参考译文: Thanks for your huge help. I'll treat you to dinner sometime.
测试样例.备注: 口语场景; someday偏正式应改用sometime; I will→I'll自然; helping...so much→huge help精简

测试样例.源文本: 该分布式系统采用微服务架构，通过容器编排实现自动扩缩容。
测试样例.翻译结果: This distributed system uses a microservice architecture and realizes automatic scaling through container arrangement.
测试样例.参考译文: The distributed system adopts a microservice architecture and achieves auto-scaling through container orchestration.
测试样例.备注: 容器编排→container orchestration不是arrangement; 自动扩缩→auto-scaling不是automatic scaling; 采用→adopts更正式

测试样例.源文本: 免疫治疗在多种恶性肿瘤中显示出持久的抗肿瘤应答。
测试样例.翻译结果: Immune therapy has shown long-lasting anti-tumor responses in many types of malignant tumors.
测试样例.参考译文: Immunotherapy has demonstrated durable antitumor responses in multiple malignant tumors.
测试样例.备注: 免疫治疗→immunotherapy不是immune therapy; 持久→durable不是long-lasting; 多种→multiple不用many types
